views.markdown: Enables rear 60 fps video that firmware already has but hides: 720p60 on iPhone 4s (H4ISP, through iOS 9.3.6) and 1080p60 on iPhone 5s (H6ISP, through iOS 12.5.8).

- 720p60 on iPhone 4s and 1080p60 on iPhone 5s
- High Profile H.264 for 5s 1080p60
- Install gated to iPhone 4s and 5s
